title: Take 5 Evening Number Watch — Number 38 Has Gone Quiet for 38 Draws
headline: Number 38 Has Gone Quiet for 38 Draws

prose.intro: The Take 5 Evening board has a new record holder for silence. Number 38 has gone 38 straight drawings without an appearance.
prose.fact: Before this run, no gap in the 50-draw sample had stretched beyond 36 drawings. Number 38 just moved the ceiling to 38.
prose.context: The usual reminder applies, and it matters most on days like this: draws are independent. A streak, a gap or an odd shape says nothing about what the next drawing will do. We log these because they describe the data, not because they change it.
